title_en: Robert Pattinson Was Watching the Upcoming Horror Film From Robert Eggers When Amazon MGM Announced He Would Be the Next James Bond
summary_en: Werwulf director Robert Eggers revealed to IGN that Robert Pattinson was watching his upcoming horror movie when the news of his casting as the next James Bond was announced today.
body_en:
Robert Pattinson was watching an upcoming horror movie when the news of his casting as the next James Bond was announced today.
IGN knows this thanks to filmmaker Robert Eggers , who directed Pattinson in The Lighthouse and just so happened to be at IGN’s Los Angeles studio today to do an interview about his next movie, Werwulf .
When I jokingly asked Eggers if he ever thought while watching Pattinson kill that seagull in The Lighthouse, “There goes the next James Bond,” he chuckled and responded:
“No, but I’m not surprised that it panned out the way that it did. And also, crazily enough, he was watching a screening of Werwulf when the news broke. And I was just texting with him about it this morning.”
So what did Pattinson think of Werwulf? “Oh, he loved it, of course,” Eggers responded with a grin.
Pattinson won the highly coveted role of James Bond after competing against the likes of Nicholas Hoult , Callum Turner, Jack Lowden, and Josh O’Connor .
According to his screen-test deal, Pattinson is looking at earning more money for making fewer Bond films than the other actors who vied for the role.
For more on the next 007, find out why Pattinson likely can’t play both Batman and James Bond going forward and read how fans reacted to Pattinson’s Bond casting .
Also be sure to check out how the media has reported on the casting of every James Bond actor, from Sean Connery to Daniel Craig, and check out the long list of every “next James Bond actor” who never ended up actually being the next James Bond .
Werwulf opens in cinemas on Christmas Day. Tickets to see it in 35mm are on sale now .
Jim Vejvoda (he/him) is IGN's Assoc. Director of Entertainment Content.
